headline: Apple’s four-pack of second-gen AirTags is $20 off
summary: Apple's four-pack of second-gen AirTags is now $79, a $20 discount. This bundle is available at Amazon and Target. It marks the lowest price yet for the four-pack.

headline: How GoFundMe became America’s backup plan
summary: GoFundMe CEO Tim Cadogan discusses the platform's role as a major fundraising tool. It helps people with expenses from medical bills to business startups. Cadogan became CEO in March 2020, navigating a chaotic period.

headline: Netflix reportedly considers opening its app to other streamers
summary: Netflix executives are reportedly exploring integrating third-party streaming services. Discussions included Peacock and Fox One, according to The New York Times. It's unclear if Netflix would sell subscriptions or just add content.

headline: De-Googled GrapheneOS is coming to Motorola’s foldables next year
summary: GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused Android version, plans Motorola smartphone support. Official rollout begins next year with flagships, then foldables and cheaper models. This open-source OS enhances security for Motorola users.

headline: Nautus Exclusive Hands-On Preview: It Feels Like Mash-Up of Steamworld Dig and Subnautica
summary: Nautus is a cozy game combining chill vibes with hidden underwater secrets. The game features quirky friends on a tropical island. It boasts a unique Cartoon Network-style aesthetic.

headline: As Hideo Kojima Turns 63, The Metal Gear Solid Creator Says He Has More Ideas Than Ever But Less Time Left to Make Them
summary: Hideo Kojima, creator of Metal Gear Solid, reflects on turning 63. He states he has more ideas now than ever before. Kojima expresses concern about having less time to bring these ideas to life.

headline: Black Myth: Zhong Kui Doesn’t Look As Epic as Wukong – and That’s Great
summary: Black Myth: Zhong Kui appears more grounded than its predecessor, Wukong. This shift could allow for a more ambitious story. The game focuses on a less epic, more nuanced narrative.

headline: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion – I Spent 44 Hours in 4 Days Playing it in Bethesda's Basement
summary: Oblivion was a defining launch title for the Xbox 360's HD Era. The author spent an intense 44 hours in 4 days playing it. Many gamers hold fond memories of this influential title.

headline: UK missiles offer may help Ukraine - but they are not what Zelensky needs most
summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham offers blueprints for Ukraine to build long-range missiles. While helpful, these missiles are not Ukraine's most critical need. The article implies other aid might be more vital to Zelensky.

headline: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
summary: The BBC investigates how the Taliban has reshaped Afghanistan five years after their return. The report covers aspects like divorce, smartphone use, and the group's control. It offers insight into life under Taliban rule.

headline: Snooker champion Graeme Dott guilty of child sex abuse
summary: Former world snooker champion Graeme Dott has been found guilty. The charges involve lewd and libidinous behavior. The victims were a girl and a boy.

headline: Race Across the World star Jo Gardiner dies aged 61 one year after son's death
summary: Former "Race Across the World" contestant Jo Gardiner has died at 61. She passed away from cancer. Her death comes one year after her son died in a crash.
